problem_statement: Make `Kokkos::complex<RealType>` fully usable in constant expressions, matching C++14 `std::complex` behavior. The public API must support `constexpr` default construction, one-argument and two-argument constructors (`complex(const RealType&)` and `complex(const RealType&, const RealType&)`), copy and move construction and assignment, and scalar assignment (`operator=(const RealType&)`). All of these must be valid in `constexpr` contexts so instances can be initialized, assigned, copied, and moved inside `constexpr` functions and `static_assert` without requiring runtime evaluation.
